documents.text:
EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT (fictional)

This Contract is between Ashgrove Design Ltd (the "Company") and Mira Okonjo (the "Employee").

1. Start
1.1 "Start Date" means 1 November 2026.
1.2 The first six (6) months of employment from the Start Date are a probationary period.

2. Holiday
2.1 Holiday must be taken by 31 December in each year.

3. Ending employment
3.1 After the probationary period, either party may terminate the employment on three (3) months' written notice.
3.2 On termination the Employee shall return all Company property.
3.3 For six (6) months after the Termination Date, the Employee shall not work for a competitor of the Company.

expect.when: six (6) months after the Termination Date

documents.text:
LOAN AGREEMENT (fictional)

This Loan Agreement is dated as of July 1, 2026 between First Harbor Bank (the "Lender") and Quayside Foods, Inc. (the "Borrower").

1. Definitions
1.1 "Maturity Date" means June 30, 2029.

2. Repayment
2.1 The Borrower shall repay the Loan in full on the Maturity Date.
2.2 Interest is payable quarterly in arrears on the last Business Day of each March, June, September and December.
2.3 The Borrower may prepay the Loan in whole or in part upon not less than ten (10) Business Days' prior written notice to the Lender.

3. Covenants
3.1 The Borrower shall deliver its annual financial statements within one hundred twenty (120) days after the end of each fiscal year.
3.2 The Borrower shall notify the Lender within five (5) Business Days of any Event of Default.
